name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring Day 30 Town Shop arbitrage extension, dual-mode peak market monetization with protected shop inventory, tiered workforce acceleration, bounded contiguous land expansion, and terminal cash conversion.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and delivers mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) across all 30 days to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom & Peak Monetization
nodes.description: Monetizes uncommitted non-shop surplus at cyclical peak premiums (>= 1.10x base price) and prevents 100/100 discard drops via price-floored clearance while strictly guarding livestock feed and shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into accelerated workforce scaling, bounded contiguous land expansion (up to 14-16 plots), decoupled seed replenishment, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: harvest ready crops with adjacent chaining, prompt shed drop-offs, watering, livestock feeding, pre-plant fertilization, planting, and terminal liquidation.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 150.0 and day <= 27)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 order slots to immediately fulfill active town shop contracts from mature shed inventory to capture 2.0x-3.5x price premiums throughout all 30 days; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) only through Day 27 when remaining contract duration strictly exceeds crop maturation time.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.20x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if crop cannot mature before contract expires or game ends (Day 30); never sell contract-matching crops on the open market when town shop contracts are pending.

attributes.condition: shed_used + incoming_worker_inventory >= 78 or (shed_used >= 35 and current_price >= 1.10 * base_price)
attributes.guidance: Dual-mode shed management: 1) Peak Monetization: When shed_used >= 35 and uncommitted commodities reach cyclical price peaks (current_price >= 1.10 * base_price), execute batch sales using at most 2 market slots to capture high margins and recycle working capital; 2) Capacity Relief: When shed_used + incoming_worker_inventory >= 78, clear uncommitted non-shop surplus with price >= 0.80 * base_price (relaxing floor to 0.50 * base_price only if shed_used >= 94 to avert discard drops).
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate commodities committed to active town shop delivery (town shops offer 2.0x-3.5x premium); never sell Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); limit open market sales to at most 2 order slots to preserve engine action bandwidth for worker dispatches.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.80 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= (midnight_payroll_due * 1.20 + (150.0 if hired_hands < 6 else 220.0)) and (hired_hands < 10 or unplanted_plots > 0 or (total_plots < 16 and uncultivated_plots <= 1) or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: Accelerate workforce expansion to 10 hands by Day 4-5 using the tiered early cash hurdle; decouple routine seed purchasing from land expansion so plots never sit barren; scale contiguous land strictly up to 14-16 plots maximum only when current plots are fully cultivated; gate seed purchases by maturation time: high-margin crops (Pumpkins, Strawberries) on Days 1-22, medium-cycle crops (Tomatoes, Carrots) on Days 23-26, and rapid-cycle Carrots/Wheat on Days 27-28, halting all seed procurement after Day 28.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allocate reinvestment capital if net cash drops below the 1.20x midnight wage buffer; do not acquire land plots beyond 16 total plots to prevent transit time dilution; halt all seed buying after Day 28 to avoid unharvested terminal waste.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands with optimized operational sequencing: 1) Harvest mature crops, chaining immediately adjacent ripe crops if carrying capacity permits before moving; 2) Drop off carried inventory at shed promptly; 3) Water dry or planted crops; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Apply available fertilizer immediately prior to planting commercial seeds; 6) Weed clearing and ground tilling. Transition 100% of workforce labor on Days 29-30 away from tilling into final watering, harvesting, and total shed liquidation, ensuring zero items remain carried by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding over harvesting or watering; do not force workers to wander seeking full capacity if adjacent ripe crops do not exist; ensure hands never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
